measurements.name: Tasman Front
measurements.range_interpretation: One approximate author description for this feature definition. Not a range endpoint, annual extrema or confidence interval.
measurements.geographic_scope: Zonal band in the Tasman Sea containing a meandering front extending from Australia to New Zealand; band center described as near 33 or 34 S.
measurements.section_orientation: Meridional breadth of a zonal occupied band; no exact paired cross-band edges extracted.
measurements.layer: Regional dynamic-height and thermal-structure synthesis; no fixed numerical layer assigned to the band breadth.
measurements.time_convention: Historical report synthesis using surveys and earlier sections; not a dated repeated-width series or annual climatology.
measurements.boundary_rule: Author-reported approximate breadth of the band occupied by a meandering front and associated eddies; not boundaries of one jet.
measurements.source_citation: Nilsson, Andrews, Lawrence, Ball and Latham (1980), Heat Capacity Mapping Mission Project HCM-051: Progress Report to 30 April 1980, RAN Research Laboratory Internal Technical Memorandum 3/80; NASA NTRS 19800022345.
measurements.source_locator: Original PDF p27 / printed p23, section 3.9; p26 / printed p22 provides separate maximum-scale context.
measurements.extraction_method: Factual numerical prose extraction from visually inspected original report; no map or boundary digitization.
measurements.source_quality_note: Microfiche reproduction of an interim technical report. Width passage visually verified. No individual jet width, exact boundary criterion or dated width sequence established.
remaining_gates: Obtain paired observed edges and a declared band/jet definition, layer and averaging rule.
Acquire comparable repeated observations before annual or seasonal margins.

comparison_context.role: Distinct scales and supports, not band interval endpoints or annual extremes.
